name: Opus 5.5 Motion Reel
about: The original showcase. Energy alternates (hook → data → mood → spectacle), no two neighbours share a palette, and each transition borrows the language of the piece it opens. mix = per-piece level trim in dB from a loudness pass on the first full mix.

page.title: Opus 5.5 Motion Reel
page.headline: Motion graphics that keep people watching.
page.lede: Thirteen pieces across twelve YouTube niches, cut as one reel. Every frame and every sound effect on this page is generated live from code, and the same code renders frame-exact MP4s for an edit.
resume: Kinetic type, animated data, map animation, 2D effects, sound design
Finance, true crime, history, gaming, space, sports, faith, tech, Cold War, cooking, comics, podcasts
H.264 MP4, 1080p60, 48 kHz stereo; one file per piece plus the full reel
page.piecesIntro: Each piece speaks one niche's visual language. Hover a thumbnail to preview it; the play button jumps the reel to that piece. Every real figure is sourced under its piece.
page.rulesIntro: Seven rules the reel follows. The numbers in this section are measured from the reel's own timeline when the page loads, so they change if the edit changes.

rules.title: Change something every two seconds
rules.text: Pattern interrupts reset attention. Across the {pieces} pieces, the longest stretch without a new visual event is {maxGap}.

rules.title: Ease every move
rules.text: Nothing moves at constant speed except clocks and counters. Expo and back curves give entrances weight and overshoot. Watch any piece at ¼× to see the curves.

rules.title: Put a sound on every hit
rules.text: The reel carries {cues} sound cues in {duration}, one every {cueEvery}, each placed on the frame of the event it belongs to.

rules.title: Let the number ride the picture
rules.text: A number means more when it is attached to the thing it measures: the tag riding the growth curve, the army count dropping on the Alps, the cities lighting up as the ring reaches them.

rules.title: Lead the eye with the camera
rules.text: One focal point at a time. The camera follows the string across the case board and rides the head of the route, so the viewer never has to search the frame.

rules.title: Match the niche’s native look
rules.text: Phosphor green for 1962, halftone for comics, parchment for 218 BC, broadcast bars for sports. Viewers read the genre in the first frame.

rules.title: Get the facts right
rules.text: Every real figure is computed or sourced, and the source is listed under each piece. Distances on the Cold War map are great-circle distances from the missile site; the finance curve is the actual annuity formula.
